name: Mathematics

declaration.notes: Calculus through MATH 2310 (or AP/transfer equivalents) is expected before declaring.

requirements.label: Additional upper-level mathematics
requirements.note: APMA 3100 can stand in for MATH 3100 and APMA 3120 for STAT 3120. At least 6 courses counted for the major must carry the MATH prefix.

notes: LOW CONFIDENCE: the official Undergraduate Record page could not be loaded and the Math department site does not publish the course list, so this follows the long-standing structure of the UVA math major (linear algebra, analysis, algebra plus electives; about 8 upper-level courses). The department FAQ confirms: at least 6 MATH-prefix courses; up to 2 courses may double count with another College major; APMA 2130/3080/3100/3120 substitutions. Concentrations (Financial Mathematics, Graduate Preparation, Probability and Statistics, Teacher Education) add specific courses. Check the Record before relying on this.

name: Music

requirements.label: Introductory course
requirements.note: One course suited to your plan; examples MUSI 2090, 3050, 3380, 3390.

requirements.label: Core: Theory
requirements.note: MUSI 3310 (Theory I), or another theory course with advisor permission.

requirements.label: Core: Critical and Cultural Studies of Music and Sound (CSMS)

notes: From the department's B.A. page. No grade below C- counts; one course can't satisfy two requirements. Performance concentration needs a 3.0 GPA and 21 extra performance credits. The department page lists no Music minor.
